description: Ministry of Health and Indigenous Medicine - The Food (Sweetners) Regulations made under Section 32 of the Food Act, No. 26 of 1980
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the Food Act, No. 26 of 1980. It establishes new legal requirements for the use of sweeteners in food products, including restrictions, labeling requirements, and maximum dosage limits. The content focuses on creating a regulatory framework for food safety and compliance, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would qualify it for Types 1-3.
